lines.text: David asks if anyone is left from Saul's house, and Ziba says Jonathan's son is in Lo-debar.
David has Mephibosheth brought from Lo-debar, and Mephibosheth falls facedown before him.
David promises to restore all of Saul's throne to Mephibosheth, who calls himself a dead dog.
David tells Ziba, who has fifteen sons and thirty servants, to work the ground for Mephibosheth.
Mephibosheth eats at David's table like one of the king's sons and lives in Jerusalem.
